(ja)༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga rin po che'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bud+da

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga rin po che'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ thabs shes bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad gshin rje'i gshed// lha mchog de la gus btud nas// sgrub thabs rjes gnang bri bar bya// 'dir bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i nang nas logs su phyung ba/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga rin po che'i do shal zhes bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du mañdzi'i khar maṇ+ḍa lar dri bzang gi thig le byas la me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ de'i mthar byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod phyogs mtshams dang*/ gtor ma shar mdun du bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ me tog slob ma la bkye bsdu'i me tog maṇ+ḍal sogs sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa la bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang*/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa dang*/ rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā nas shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/

bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ji tsam nus pa brjod pa'i mthar/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed nas/ rang skad cig gis dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal gshin rje'i gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥzhes phyag bya/ oṃ shrī rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can gyi don byas/

slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dang smin ma ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal dang*/ skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ gshin rje'i tshogs skrag par byed pa/ ma he dmar po'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal gshin rje'i gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de la gong tshogs zhing ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa māḥdzaḥ sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de la oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rā+ai bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/

sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par mos nas/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba btab nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan rang la thim par bsam pa ni bdag bskyed do// gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sogs nas tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ'i bar gong ltar bya/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing sogs sh+lo ka gsum gyis spyan drangs/ de la mchod nas rgyas gdab kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya'o// mchod pa bsang sbyangs dang byin rlabs snga ma ltar las dharma ra ṇi ta mi dgos/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar rol mo bcas/ mtshan sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma nang mchod dang chus sbyangs la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ye ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa gong du bshad pa ltar brjod/

mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bsams la spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas sngags bzla ba 'dod don gsol 'dab kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya'o// gsum pa ni/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub 'phral slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang bsdu na/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong dang*/ zhe sdang la spyod pa'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong dang*/ gti mug la spyod pa'i gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong dang*/ dug gsum cha mnyam pa la spyod pa'i gnyen por gsang sngags kyi sde snod nyi khri chig stong rnams gsungs pa las/ 'dir gsang sngags kyi sde snod yin la/ de la 'jog byed du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te gang zag phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba rnams la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang so so'i rgyud rnams gsungs/

gang zag 'bring phyi lus ngag gi spyod pa dang nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod pa la dga' ba rnams spyod pa'i rgyud la rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud rnams gsungs/ gang zag mchog ting nge 'dzin kho na la gtso bor spyod pa la dga' ba rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rtsa bshad cha mthun rnams gsungs/ gang zag ches mchog tu gyur pa nang ting nge 'dzin gong na med par spyod pa la dga' ba rnams la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams gsungs pa las 'dir rnal 'byor bla med yin/ de la'ang pha bla na med pa dang*/ ma bla na med pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa bla na med pa'i rgyud dang gsum las/ 'dir pha bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i phyir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang*/ dgongs pa lung ston dang*/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ lha mo bzhis zhus dang*/ ye shes rdo rje'i kun las btus pa'i rgyud rnams gsungs/ gdul bya zhe sdang can rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i phyir du gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud rnams gsungs/ gdul bya gti mug can rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i phyir du rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud gsungs pa yin pa las/ 'dir gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor la rtsa ba'i rgyud gshin rje dgra nag la brten nas lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la lugs srol du ma dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud gdong drug gi rgyud la lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bka' srol las zhang lugs dang*/ rwa lugs dang*/ gye re lugs dang gsum du yod pa las/ phyi ma chad nas med do// las tshogs gtso bor bton pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa 'di la brten nas mthu stobs dbang phyug rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags la bka' babs pa rgyud kyi dngos bstan lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/

rgyud de nyid dang gshin rje dgra nag nas kha bskangs nas lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ yang rtog bdun la brten nas grub chen la li ta badz+ra nas zhang shes bla ma sogs la bka' babs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu ma zhes grags pa dang*/ yang rtog bdun la brten nas grub chen a mo gha badz+ra nas legs par brgyud/ skyo 'od 'byung sogs la bka' babs pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun pa'i dbang dang*/ grol lam la bskyed rim lha bdun gyi sgrub thabs bka'i 'khor lo dang*/ rdzogs rim rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang bcas pa la skyo lugs zhes yongs su grags pa dang*/ yang rtog bdun la brten nas bla ma nā ro pa nas rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa la 'jigs byed sa lugs zhes grags pa ste deng sang lugs de dag gi bka' srol ma chad tsam du yod do// gshin rje'i gshed dmar po la rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa dang*/ nyer gnyis pa gnyis yod pa las rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa'i le'u dang pos gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bstan te rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa sogs las brgyud/ chag lo tsā ba sogs la bka' babs pa gshed dmar lha lnga zhes yongs su grags pa dang*/ le'u brgyad pa nas lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni grub chen dpal 'dzin nas brgyud/ rong pa rga lo sogs la bka' srol byung ba la gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma zhes grags pa yin la/ 'dir rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje sogs nas brgyud pa bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba nas rje btsun sa skya pa kun dga' snying po la bka' babs pa'i zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba sngon du legs par grub zin nas/

gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams bya dgos pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la dpal gshin rje'i gshed dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi phung po khams dang zhes sogs kyis/ slob ma rnams bdag bskyed ltar zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/

de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ rol mo bya zhing dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes gnang dngos bya ba la gsum yod pa las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas te me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sngags gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te slob dpon la me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzungs lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig

gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed yi dam du gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du gshin rje'i gshed yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ ngag bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyangs kyis bye nas byon pa khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa byas/ de'i ngang nas lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par 'gyur te rang la thim zhing*/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam pa gyur te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon de yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan nyid can rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/

de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ sems bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi rnams grub nas mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa rnams kyang drin lan du 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ ces bya ba de rnams kyis dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rjes gnang legs par gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang*/ gsum pa rjes ni mchod pa kha bsos nas/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas bstod pa'i bar dang*/ 'dod don gsol gdab rnams gong du bstan pa ltar brjod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol byas pas/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas gnas gsum bsrung*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyi bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam rnams bya'o// 'di sbyar dge bas bdag sogs rnams// bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs las grol// bde chen khang bzang nyams dga' bar// zag med sku bzhis rol par shog /dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga rin po che'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di ni mdo khams stod kyi a gro'i sa'i cha gra'u zhes par rigs kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa rdo rje'i 'dzin pa dkon mchog rnam rgyal pas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs pa chen po sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pa brang ti'i sprang btsun ga ga na shrī bha dras dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo mgo zla ba'i yar tshes gcig la shrī e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod thar pa rtser myur bar sbyar ba'o// pha mas gtso byas sems can thams cad bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa las grol nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig/

༈ /rjes gnang dkyus su mi dgos kyang*/ rkyen sel lta bu'i skabs su chos srung gi rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gi rigs 'gre sbyar ba'i gtor ma'i bka' bsgo tsam mdzad pa phyag len 'ga' zhig la snang bas de ltar na/ sbyor ba'i skabs su tshom bu'i mdun du dpal gtor dmar po rgyan ldan gtor gdugs kyis spras pa bsham/ dngos gzhi mdun bskyed skabs de dang tshom bu gnyis ka lhan cig tu lhar bskyed/ rjes gnang gi skabs/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas zhes pa'i mjug tu/ mtha' rten gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba'i slad du/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar por gsal ba'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa la slob dpon gyis ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// sngags gnyis kyi mthar a dhiṣ+ṭhī na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di nyid la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/

bar gdon 'byung po rgyal btsan gyi gnod pa/ khyad par du bdud dang gshin rje'i bar gcod/ gzhan yang gzugs can mi'i gnod pa/ gzugs med lha 'dre'i gnod pa/ pha rol gyi byad kha rbod gtong*/ mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug gis mtshon mi mthun mi 'dod pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa snyan pa dang grags pa lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo'am dbyar dus kyi mtsho ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khams gsum srid gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis khab len gyi rdos lcags phye bsdus pa ltar rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po'i rigs thams cad dbye ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ gsad pa la sogs pa drag shul gyi las chen rnam pa bcu gnyis kyis rtswa sbur mes bsregs pa bzhin du tshar bcad par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzhan yang ji ltar bsams pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub cing mthar thug tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rjen las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes dang*/ mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas gtor ma'i lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brjod/ spro na/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pas me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang bcas bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/

che ba'i che mchog lta bus mtshon mdo rgyud las byung ba'i bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs sogs man chad dkyus ltar bya'o// //maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
